mapper.insert: insert into ${ dynamicTableNameProxy.deliveryAddress} (primary_Key, enterprise_code, owner, address_detail, default_address, customer, vender, consignee_Name, consignee_Phone, address_Region) values (#{data.primaryKey}, ${ dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode}, #{data.owner}, #{data.addressDetail}, #{data.defaultAddress}, #{data.customerCode}, #{data.vender}, #{data.consigneeName}, #{data.consigneePhone}, #{data.addressRegion})
mapper.select: SELECT primary_key, owner, consignee_name, consignee_phone, address_region, address_detail, default_address, customer, vender, enterprise_code FROM ${tableName} WHERE enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND vender = #{vender} AND owner = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(default_address, false) DESC, id DESC
